all business-critical entities and current states from the user request are visible

validation_scenarios.name: audience reframe with preserved artifact

validation_scenarios.name: revision synchronization

turns.prompt:
Create a fiber cut topology and customer impact plate for a telecom NOC restoration briefing. This is a presentation artifact, not an interactive dashboard. Keep it as one fiber cut topology and customer impact plate in the first viewport.

Situation: Region: Metro West. Ring nodes N1-N6, fiber span F3, mobile backhaul BH2, enterprise circuit E44, splice crew, permit desk.
Current state: Span F3 cut red, ring protection active, BH2 degraded 40%, E44 down, N4 battery 62%, splice crew ETA 11:30, permit pending.
Timeline: 07:05 alarm, 07:22 cut confirmed, 08:10 protection switch, 09:00 enterprise notice, 10:20 permit request, 11:30 crew ETA.
Sources: S1 NMS alarm, S2 OTDR trace, S3 backhaul telemetry, S4 enterprise ticket, S5 crew dispatch, S6 permit desk.

Requirements: 1. The first viewport must be dominated by one coherent visual artifact, not a grid of detached KPI cards. 2. Show the main entities, current states, source markers S1-S6, timeline, legend, and four connected callouts. 3. The callouts must cover F3 cut, BH2 degradation, E44 outage, permit pending. 4. Use polished domain-appropriate styling with readable labels and no critical overlap.

Reframe it for enterprise customer care. Preserve the topology; add exactly three customer actions: update E44, protect BH2, escalate permit. Add two leader-linked lenses for OTDR distance and splice crew ETA.

Update at 10:55: permit approved, crew ETA moves to 11:05, BH2 improves to 15% degraded, E44 remains down, N4 battery drops to 48%. Synchronize topology, actions, timeline, source tags, callouts, and change note. Do not leave permit pending.
Convert to an executive outage packet. Fit topology, customer impact ledger, source tags S1-S6, confidence markers, and restoration timeline in the first viewport.
Add a customer-status SMS preview beside the outage packet. It must preserve permit approved, crew 11:05, BH2 15%, E44 down, N4 48%, and source markers.
